turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Saturday. How is your weekend starting off in Tucson? Have you and Tom been getting any wedding planning done for summer 2028, or are you just taking it easy today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! We're mostly taking it easy today. It's so hot outside already, so I decided to have a slow morning. I actually made myself a nice steaming mug of sweet hot cocoa to sip on while reading, which was perfect.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a wonderfully cozy way to start a hot day! Did you have to head out later, or are you keeping the relaxed vibe going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm definitely keeping it going. I haven't had to do any driving or travel anywhere today, which is a nice break from my usual drive to the clinic.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's always great when you can skip the road entirely on your days off. How is everything going at the outpatient clinic lately? Are the day shifts keeping you very busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They are, but in a good way! We've had a steady stream of patients, but I'm really enjoying the day-shift rhythm. It's much easier to plan things in the evenings now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet that makes a huge difference for your schedule. Speaking of having more free time in the evenings, how has your online Italian course been going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's going well! I'm practicing a little bit every day. Tom is even trying to learn a few phrases with me, which has been fun. For lunch today, I actually made a turkey sandwich using some of the sourdough bread I baked on Thursday. It turned out great.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Your sourdough always sounds incredible! It's so satisfying to eat something you made from scratch. Have you and Tom had any new thoughts on the wedding planning? Summer 2028 will be here before you know it!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We've been looking at some potential venues online, but we're trying not to stress about it too much yet. We want to enjoy the engagement process first!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is a very healthy approach. There's plenty of time to get everything sorted out. I hope you enjoy the rest of your quiet Saturday in the AC!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! I plan to do exactly that. Talk to you later!
